name: petclinic-application
description: Java 17 Spring Boot 3.1 web application providing the PetClinic user interface and HTTP endpoints for owners, pets, visits, veterinarians, validation, caching, and actuator operations.

name: database-runtime
description: Configures database runtime modes for the in-memory H2 database and persistent MySQL or PostgreSQL profiles, including datasource settings and initialization behavior.

name: local-database-compose
